critical_code_review_comments: pdf_reports.py (~310 lines, 4 endpoints + helpers) — clean structure, proper async/await, _id excluded via projections, RBAC helper, tz-aware datetimes, currency stays as constant 'EGP' (acceptable for MVP, could be per-compound later).

two_factor.py (~225 lines, 5 endpoints + models + helpers) — RFC 6238 compliant, TOTP valid_window=1 (handles clock skew), backup codes bcrypt-hashed and one-time-use via two_factor_backup_used index list, temp_token uses scope='2fa_pending' to prevent misuse as access_token. JWT_SECRET reused from auth_deps — good. ELIGIBLE_ROLES whitelist prevents residents from enabling 2FA.

Minor: pdf_reports unit_statement queries resident_charges/payments using both due_date string and created_at ISO via $or — robust but slightly heavy. Consider adding indexes on (resident_id, due_date) and (resident_id, payment_date).
Minor: two_factor.disable does not require password — only TOTP code. RFC permits this but adding password re-auth would be more defensive (recommend P2 hardening).
Minor: backup codes are returned only once on verify-setup (correct UX) — frontend MUST instruct user to save them. Verified via UI screenshot that this is communicated.
